name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden Fridge Magnet Bottle Opener
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and durable stainless steel, offering a sturdy, practical, and eye-catching finish.
    - Features a 3-layer wooden construction that creates a dimensional look while enhancing durability.
    - Layer 1 is made of wood with a 3mm thickness and supports 1-sided printing.
    - Layer 2 is made of wood with a 5mm thickness and has no printing, serving as the structural middle layer.
    - Layer 3 is made of wood with a 3mm thickness and supports 1-sided printing.
    - Includes a built-in round stainless steel beer bottle opener and disc magnets for convenient fridge display and easy access.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall product size: 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
    - Round beer bottle opener size: 4 cm ~ 1.57 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology on wooden base for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1: 1-sided printing
    - Layer 2: No printing
    - Layer 3: 1-sided printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative fridge magnet and a built-in bottle opener.
    - Designed to attach easily to refrigerators or other magnetic surfaces for convenient storage and display.
    - The integrated stainless steel opener allows quick and easy bottle opening whenever needed.
    - Suitable for kitchens, home bars, patios, man caves, parties, and entertainment spaces.
    - Perfect for combining decoration, personalization, and everyday practicality in one product.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, husbands, grandpas, brothers, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, housewarmings, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for beer lovers, home bar enthusiasts, BBQ fans, and anyone who enjoys custom novelty accessories.
    - A thoughtful gift for kitchens, bars, patios, and entertainment areas.
    - Great for party favors, personalized keepsakes, and functional decorative gifts.
    - Adds a fun, rustic, and memorable touch to any fridge or bar space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden Fridge Magnet Bottle Opener

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
